sections.kicker: Prepared for Saccro by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site and your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Saccro has a real reason to exist. It is on a ticker, below the fold.
sections.keep: The sourcing line, "Cuerpo fructífero, no micelio sobre grano". It is a hard fact most mushroom brands cannot say.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.quote: Cuerpo fructífero, no micelio sobre grano
pins.what: The strongest claim on the page runs by in the bottom ticker.
pins.why: It is the reason to pick Saccro over every other mushroom powder, and it moves past in small type.
pins.how: Make this the headline and explain it in one plain sentence.
pins.label: Your ticker
pins.cost: Shoppers cannot tell Saccro from a cheaper mushroom powder.

pins.quote: Convierta cualquier bebida en una infusión de hongos.
pins.what: The hero describes a use, in a formal voice.
pins.why: Convierta is the usted form. It sounds like a pharmacy, while the panela and the wooden box say craft.
pins.how: Pick one voice for the product and use it on the box, the site and Instagram.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: The product looks handmade and sounds like a supplement.

pins.area: A box printed with map coordinates on a rough wooden shelf
pins.what: The box carries coordinates and a stamped saccro mark.
pins.why: It is a distinct, specific detail no wellness brand copies. The site never explains it.
pins.how: Tell the story of the coordinates and use them as a signature.
pins.label: Your packaging
pins.cost: The most original thing on the box is left unexplained.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Saccro. I spent some time on your site. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Saccro's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
